clusters.title: [Feature]: Add direct shortcuts to macOS system panels and utilities
clusters.summary: ### Problem or Motivation ## Feature request Many macOS system controls require opening System Settings or navigating through multiple menus. Vorssaint already provides quick actions and Command Bar access, so it would be useful to open specific macOS system panels directly. ###

evidence.label: [Feature]: Add direct shortcuts to macOS system panels and utilities
[Feature]: Add instant macOS Space switching without transition animation
